Benign.description: Ordinary, non-malicious network activity (web browsing, streaming, standard business protocols).

SSH-Patator.description: Automated repeated login attempts against remote SSH administrative access.

FTP-Patator.description: Automated repeated credential guessing against FTP file transfer services.

DoS GoldenEye.description: A denial-of-service attack designed to exhaust web server connection pools and memory.

DoS Hulk.description: A high-volume HTTP flood attack designed to bypass web caching layers and crash servers.

DoS Slowhttptest.description: A slow-rate HTTP attack that holds server connections open until connection tables fill up.

DoS slowloris.description: A low-bandwidth attack sending incomplete HTTP headers to tie up server worker threads.

DDoS.description: A distributed high-rate traffic flood originating from multiple sources to overwhelm target infrastructure.

PortScan.description: Reconnaissance probing to discover which ports, services, and system versions are accessible.

Bot.description: Traffic between a compromised internal device and an external botnet Command-and-Control controller.

Web Attack-Brute Force.description: Repeated automated password guessing to unlawfully gain access to a web application account.

Web Attack-XSS.description: Injecting malicious browser scripts into web parameters to target application visitors.

Web Attack-Sql Injection.description: Injecting database commands to illicitly extract sensitive records or bypass authentication.

Infiltration.description: Post-exploitation lateral movement and internal discovery following an initial breach.

Heartbleed.description: Exploiting OpenSSL memory disclosure flaw to illicitly read server memory and private keys.
